questions.q: Which Bixolon model should NOT be positioned as the ZD421 displacement product?
questions.e: The XD3-40 shares the printhead/motors but is lower spec with a single feed button — position it as a value option, not the displacement product.

questions.q: How does the XD5-40d's direct-thermal speed at 203 dpi compare to the Zebra ZD421?
questions.e: The XD5-40d tops out at ~7 ips (178 mm/s) DT vs the ZD421's ~6 ips (152 mm/s) — roughly 17% more throughput per shift.

questions.q: When should a rep lead with Bixolon for a ZD421 displacement?
o: On every deal — it's the default; Toshiba is quoted only on explicit customer request or an existing Toshiba estate
Only where aggressive price drives the deal
Only where the software prints direct-to-port ZPL
questions.e: Bixolon is the primary and the default on all displacement and new business. Toshiba enters only when the customer specifically requests it or a Toshiba estate / service-network requirement applies.

questions.q: What is the first question to ask before quoting a Bixolon replacement for a Zebra label printer?
o: Whether their software prints through the Windows driver or sends ZPL direct to the port
questions.e: The print path decides the deployment. Windows-driver estates need a driver reinstall and default-printer change; direct-to-port ZPL estates like Intact Xline are proven zero-config drop-ins because the printer auto-senses ZPL.
